I answered Tobias in a thread on his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the depot was **Southgate**.

This comes from Priyanka Sundaram's posts in that channel on 3 Sep 2025. She wrote that Southgate dispatch had totes stacked beside door 4 while labels weren't printing, and later that Southgate had cleared the backlog once printing was back. I only read that channel, and Tobias is a member of it.
